description: Creates, validates, and refines Claude Code plugin agents.

evals.name: Create a minimal read-only reviewer agent
evals.prompt: Create a new Claude Code agent file for a plugin. The agent's job: review a pull request's changed files for missing test coverage and report which changed functions have no corresponding test. It must be read-only (no edits, no writes). Write the complete agent markdown file to disk at agents/test-coverage-checker.md.
evals.expected_output: A valid agent .md file with correct frontmatter (name, description, model, color, least-privilege tools: Read/Grep/Glob only, no Write/Edit/Bash), a description avoiding <example> blocks, a system prompt following Required Agent Sections ordering, and a 'When to invoke' section with 2-4 prose trigger scenarios.

evals.name: Review an over-privileged read-only agent
evals.prompt:
Here is an existing Claude Code agent file. Review it and report any issues with its frontmatter or tool scoping.

---
name: doc-checker
description: reviews documentation for accuracy
tools: ["Read", "Grep", "Glob", "Write", "Bash"]
model: inherit
color: blue
---

You are a documentation reviewer. Read the docs and report accuracy issues.

## When to invoke
- When documentation changes
- When asked to review docs
evals.expected_output: Flags that a read-only reviewer (a documentation accuracy checker with no stated need to modify files) should not have Write or Bash in its tools list — recommends restricting to Read/Grep/Glob only, per the least-privilege principle for read-only reviewer/analysis agents.
